pages.text: How to obtain: $(bold)Craft$()$(br2)Royal Jelly Bottle (The Bumblezone) + Eye of Ender (shapeless).

Royal Jelly can be obtained from the Bee Queen - check Bumblezone advancements for more.$(br2)To enter the Bumblezone, throw an Ender Pearl or push yourself with a piston into a beehive. Remember to bring tools, wood, and building blocks.
